dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: We rest so that we can fight more effectively. Exhausted soldiers endanger both themselves and their comrades — that is something every commander knows.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: However, resting doesn't mean we can drop our guard completely. Our enemies do not act according to our timetables, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You say this place is safe, but... Well, take that wolf over there. He looks pretty suspicious to me.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I can surpass my past self by constantly challenging powerful foes. In that sense, I must say that this place suits me perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: More importantly, no one will die even if we fail, so we can actually focus all our energies on honing our skills.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: So please, do not hesitate to send me into battle.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I usually don't get a chance to be around this many books unless I'm organizing the Lightkeeper archives.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Let's have a look at this one... Hmm, it's about Liyue's history... The Millelith mentioned here seem to share some similarities with us Lightkeepers...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Sure enough, there will always be those who fight to protect their homeland. We are not alone.
